text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A massive crowd gathered for the Japan 
Cup. Mayano Top Gun could be seen among 
them as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian has simulated racing against 
the "Emperor" countless times. ...Yet 
picturing a victory does not come easily.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Yet, it wasn't insurmountable. Her 
heartbeat pounded with fiery passion.
